title: Slip Coding.pdf — page 28
text:
Site level Minimum & Maximum % 
Deductibles
• If a percentage deductible is given with a minimum and/or maximum 
value, create a column for the TIV of each location in your highlighted 
criteria and order a based on TIV .
• In a new column, calculate the resulting deductible with the relevant % 
deductible applied.
• If the value is below the minimum, code the minimum deductible value 
in these cells.
• If the value is below the maximum, code the maximum deductible 
value in these cells.
• If the value is in between the min & max, code the % deductible.
